name: Exp_ColorJMomentum
summary: This EA trades based on the ColorJMomentum custom indicator, which applies JMA smoothing to a Momentum oscillator. It opens buy positions when the smoothed momentum turns upward and sell positions when it turns downward, with configurable entry/exit direction controls and money management options.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorJMomentum自定义指标进行交易，该指标对动量振荡器应用JMA平滑处理。当平滑动量向上转折时开多仓，向下转折时开空仓，并提供可配置的入场/出场方向控制和资金管理选项。
strategy_analysis: 策略核心是基于JMA平滑后的Momentum动量指标的方向变化进行交易。入场条件：当Value[1]<Value[2]（动量从下降趋势转为上升趋势）且Value[0]>Value[1]（当前值继续上升）时开多仓；当Value[1]>Value[2]（动量从上升趋势转为下降趋势）且Value[0]<Value[1]（当前值继续下降）时开空仓。出场条件：多仓在动量转为下降趋势时平仓，空仓在动量转为上升趋势时平仓，同时设有固定的StopLoss和TakeProfit。仓位管理支持五种模式：按自由保证金比例、按余额比例、按净自由保证金比例、按净余额比例和固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，MMMode参数选择计算模式。该策略属于趋势跟随型动量交易系统，利用JMA平滑减少虚假信号，但在震荡市中容易产生频繁的来回交易。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy core is trading based on directional changes in the JMA-smoothed Momentum indicator. Entry conditions: a buy position opens when Value[1]<Value[2] (momentum transitions from downtrend to uptrend) and Value[0]>Value[1] (current value continues rising); a sell position opens when Value[1]>Value[2] (momentum transitions from uptrend to downtrend) and Value[0]<Value[1] (current value continues falling). Exit conditions: long positions close when momentum shifts to a downtrend, short positions close when momentum shifts to an uptrend, with fixed StopLoss and TakeProfit levels also applied. Position sizing supports five modes: by free margin percentage, by balance percentage, by net free margin percentage, by net balance percentage, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled via the MM parameter for risk ratio and MMMode parameter for calculation mode. The strategy is a trend-following momentum trading system that uses JMA smoothing to reduce false signals, but it can generate frequent whipsaw trades in ranging markets.

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 手数计算模式（自由保证金/余额/净保证金/净余额/固定手数）
parameters.description_en: MM mode (free margin/balance/loss margin/loss balance/fixed lot)

parameters.name: IPC
parameters.description: 价格类型（收盘/开盘/最高/最低/中间/典型/加权等）

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 信号计算使用的K线索引
parameters.description_en: Bar index used for signal calculation

pros: 使用JMA平滑算法减少动量指标的虚假信号，提高信号质量
提供灵活的资金管理模式，支持五种仓位计算方式
独立的买入和卖出的开仓/平仓开关，允许单向交易或仅做信号通知
有新K线检测机制（IsNewBar），避免同一K线内重复交易
止损止盈参数完整，且盈亏比2:1较为合理
pros_en: Uses JMA smoothing algorithm to reduce false signals from the Momentum indicator, improving signal quality
Provides flexible money management with five position sizing modes
Independent buy/sell open/close switches allow one-directional trading or signal-only use
New bar detection mechanism (IsNewBar) prevents repeated trades within the same bar
Complete stop-loss and take-profit parameters with a reasonable 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio
cons: 没有检查是否已存在同方向持仓，可能重复开仓导致仓位叠加
缺少点差过滤，在高点差环境下动量信号可能失效
固定止损止盈不考虑市场波动性（ATR），在不同品种上效果差异大
依赖自定义指标ColorJMomentum，增加了部署复杂性和依赖性
没有多时间框架确认机制，单一指标信号容易受噪音干扰
cons_en: No check for existing same-direction positions, potentially leading to repeated entries and position stacking
No spread filter; momentum signals may fail in high-spread environments
Fixed stop-loss and take-profit don't account for market volatility (ATR), causing inconsistent results across instruments
Depends on the custom ColorJMomentum indicator, adding deployment complexity and external dependency
No multi-timeframe confirmation mechanism; single-indicator signals are susceptible to noise
improvements: 增加持仓检查逻辑，避免同方向重复开仓造成仓位过度叠加
引入ATR动态止损止盈，根据市场波动性自动调整风险参数
增加点差过滤和多时间框架确认，提高信号可靠性
improvements_en: Add position checking logic to avoid repeated same-direction entries causing position over-stacking
Introduce ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit that auto-adjusts based on market volatility
Add spread filter and multi-timeframe confirmation to improve signal reliability

risk_points: 无同方向持仓检查，可能导致同一信号反复开仓造成仓位过度集中
固定止损止盈不适应不同市场波动环境，可能在低波动时止损过宽、高波动时止损过窄
依赖外部自定义指标文件，若指标缺失将导致EA初始化失败
risk_points_en: No same-direction position check may cause repeated entries on the same signal, leading to over-concentrated positions
Fixed stop-loss/take-profit doesn't adapt to different market volatility regimes—too wide in low volatility, too narrow in high volatility
Dependency on external custom indicator file; if the indicator is missing, EA initialization will fail

It opens buy positions when the smoothed momentum turns upward and sell positions when it turns downward, with configurable entry/exit direction controls and money management options.
